title: Earthily Garlicky Argentinian Herring Paella
description: A savory one-pot dish featuring herring, garlic, and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a paella pan. This Argentinian-inspired recipe combines the earthy flavors of garlic and herring with a crunchy texture from the fry.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped herring fillets and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth, uncooked white rice, and lemon juice, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Let the paella rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
